# How to sign up a patron for home visits

Use this when a patron, a family member, or a partner asks about the [[Hearthside Visits|homebound service]].

## Steps

1. Confirm the patron has a card, or issue one over the phone with an address check.
2. Fill in the interest form: favorite authors, genres, print size, audiobooks or not, and the best week of the month to visit.
3. Send the form to [[Wendeline Okafor]], who matches the patron with a volunteer within two weeks.
4. Tell the patron that the first visit brings a starter bag and that items go out for six weeks.

## Who qualifies

See [[Hearthside Visits#Who can join]]. Temporary needs, such as recovery from surgery, count if they last three months or more.
